description: VyGo is a Sri Lankan online bus-booking and fleet-management platform (demo/dev build). Passengers search trips between Sri Lankan cities, pick exact seats on a live bus map, lock seats for 10 minutes while paying by card via PayHere (sandbox in this demo), and board with a QR e-ticket. Cancellation is allowed up to 60 minutes before departure with a 5% fee. Seed data is created only under the dev Spring profile. Canonical fact sheet: /llms.txt.

endpoints.name: assistant_chat
endpoints.auth: public (no JWT required; an optional Bearer token personalizes booking lookups)

message.description: Free-text message to the VyGo Assistant

sessionId.description: Optional; tolerated by the default Jackson configuration but not yet declared on AssistantChatRequest (currently ignored)

type.description: none = no action; search = run trip search with data.from/data.to/data.date; navigate = go to data.path

data.description: Action payload: for search {from, to, date}; for navigate {path}

keyIntents.name: search_trips
keyIntents.description: Find available trips between two Sri Lankan cities for the current date

keyIntents.name: my_bookings
keyIntents.description: List the signed-in passenger's bookings (guest is redirected to login)

keyIntents.name: refund_policy
keyIntents.description: Explain the cancellation and refund rules: 60 minutes before departure, 5% fee

keyIntents.name: fare_lookup
keyIntents.description: Show fares from seeded fare rules for a route and bus type

keyIntents.name: routes
keyIntents.description: Describe the route catalogue (146 seeded routes) and navigate to the Routes page

keyIntents.name: expressway
keyIntents.description: Answer about expressway services; E001 (Southern Expressway) and E003 (Colombo-Katunayake Expressway) have seed data; E002 has none

keyIntents.name: login
keyIntents.description: Explain login and registration, including demo accounts

keyIntents.name: operator
keyIntents.description: Explain operator onboarding: register, get approved, manage buses, routes, schedules and reports

keyIntents.name: conductor
keyIntents.description: Explain the conductor panel: onboard booking, QR ticket validation, reconciliation

keyIntents.name: alerts
keyIntents.description: Explain delay alerts and reminders managed from the Notifications page

facts.value: 146 routes seeded in dev (107 catalogue + 4 hand-built 01/02/30/34: Colombo-Kandy, Colombo-Galle, Colombo-Jaffna, Kandy-Galle + 35 new expressway/classic routes)
E001 (Southern Expressway) and E003 (Colombo-Katunayake Expressway) seeded: 24 E001 routes and 2 E003 routes (Colombo-Katunayake Airport, Colombo-Negombo); E002 has no seed data

16 approved network operators: Expressway Bus, SLTB, SLTTS Katubadda, Singhegiri Transport, Jayalath Traders, SLTB Kataragama, Dilanka Express, GreenLeaf, Liyanage Express, SK Sons, Namali Travels, Namunukula Highway Express, NCG Express, Vishmitha Highway, Maleesha Tours, Jaffna Travels (plus demo operator Lanka Express)
QR e-ticket per seat, shown to conductor at boarding

sources.description: Seed data: routes, schedules, fare rules, demo accounts, the single seeded passenger booking
Trip search, seat materialization, available-seat counting, LKR 1000 fallback fare
Fare formula: (baseFare + perKmRate x distanceKm) x surgeMultiplier
Booking lifecycle and cancellation (window + fee from AppProperties)
Seat locking with 10-minute TTL from AppProperties
Assistant intent engine: search, bookings, routes, cancel, FAQ, LLM upgrade
Response record: reply, suggestions, action (citations field is the proposed addition)
Request record: message (@NotBlank, max 500); sessionId not yet declared
REST API contract reference (repo-only, not served by Vite)
